candidates.name: Plantar calcaneal enthesophyte
support_spans: Magnetic resonance imaging of the left foot showed no thickening of the plantar fascia and no signal alteration in adjacent soft tissues or bone marrow. However, MRI revealed a pedunculated bony protrusion arising from the posterolateral plantar aspect of the calcaneus, measuring approximately 1.1 cm × 0.9 cm.
candidates.why: The presence of a pedunculated bony protrusion on MRI suggests an enthesophyte, which is a bony growth that can cause pain and inflammation.
